canonical_reserve_surface.api: Exact string from the14 API name table, no int/bool/alias/coercion.
canonical_reserve_surface.numeric_ids: Native header api_id/actor_id are derived fixed table codes after validation; kernel.reserve_call(state,target_ref,api_id,actor_id,...) in the base is superseded, not a second public API.
canonical_reserve_surface.observe_return_boundary: The base observe_python_return spelling describes the kernel dispatch wrapper INTERNAL first-visible completion step, not an ordinary public setter accepting a caller assertion of success. Only that actual active invocation records its return/original exception. A ready/returned argument alone is no authority.

case_count: 25 existing finite data-case IDs retained; these are additional exact assertions within existing cases, not a new runtime experiment or implementation.

current_format_rule.default_native_profile: Even fully committed native cells do not make the current native/physical wire profile qualified. Current native bank snapshots remain native-profile-unqualified until a separately reviewed format/profile explicitly represents native state/identity/actor semantics. The next source-pure tests can inspect exact KernelSnapshots using an explicitly synthetic store; a separately proven structural legacy-compatible projection is data-only, never native qualification.
current_format_rule.persisted_artifacts: No unnamed producer-native raw page/15th output is added. The existing14-artifact universe does NOT already persist this extra native state. Until explicit later native format/storage/physical profile design, native-state inspectability is source-issued IN-MEMORY only. A separately authorized trusted harness may retain its own evidence under its own names without making it a producer publication/gate.
current_format_rule.pure_codec_limit: The existing codec can encode valid caller dictionaries as data. A caller manually omitting native fields from a dictionary does not turn that output into a source-issued native snapshot or complete evidence; producer adapters must preserve/refuse actual source observations. Source4/codec files and existing evidence are unchanged.
current_format_rule.required_refusal: Any genuine producer adapter into those current formats must refuse an unsupported native axis/state or uncommitted payload with existing codec.FormatError(LEGACY_NOT_REPRESENTABLE) BEFORE issuing encoded/projection data. No staged->ordinaryUNOBSERVED, staged->COMMITTED, payload-bit drop or diagnostic retagging. This includes UNOBSERVED with changed rawbits from the pre-stage gap.

existing_case_expectation_closures.add: KernelSnapshot retains STAGED_UNCOMMITTED/rawbits101 exactly; snapshot and accessor immutable. Current ROLE1/legacy adapter raises LEGACY_NOT_REPRESENTABLE and does not change snapshot/store.
UNOBSERVED with rawbits101 remains inspectable as unknown, never ordinaryzero/known101; unsupported currentwire projection refuses.
Committed native handle survives same original conversionMemoryError and snapshot capture; no currentnative-profile completion is inferred from ordinary structural encoding.
Cache-only repeated snapshot/axis access does not heal/stage/commit/doublefold; earlier snapshots do not alias later mutable storage.

planned_source_name.state: BothPLANNED_SOURCE/UNBUILT; no file is implied to exist from a name.

scope: Three existing compatibility points only: one reserve signature/planned wrapper name, explicit immutable staged-state inspection, and strict current-wire representability. Base16aa and numeric4cf remain unchanged. No native implementation, source execution or output universe change.

snapshot_surface.budget: Immutable native cell snapshots/reference metadata have their own bounded live/transient retention cost. Up to256B native cell image per reserved row plus kernel clock/wrapper metadata is NOT silently paid by Source4 wire256B or its generated store. Exact actual representation/phase lifetime must be budgeted before native/physical profile qualification; no cap or RSS claim is made here.
snapshot_surface.immutability: Snapshot freezes/copied metadata at a quiescent point; it never exposes a live mutable native bank alias. Old issued snapshots do not change when another reservation/cell/wrapper/clock/close progresses. Getters are cache-only, no resample/rebuild/commit/heal. RawCallView of the live bank is readonly and may only be inspected under its specified quiescent lifetime.
snapshot_surface.meaning: raw_payload_bits retains exact native cell bits even when value authority is unknown. known_value is unavailable/None for UNOBSERVED and STAGED_UNCOMMITTED, not guessed0; COMMITTED/nativeNULL remains distinguished by native_state/kind/rawbits and committed interpretation. An interruption after payload write but before stage can leave UNOBSERVED with changed rawbits; that information is preserved.
snapshot_surface.other_facts: RawCallSnapshot also preserves actual kernel wrapper-return/exception/clock cells as separate axes; native RAW_EXIT_PREPARED/conversion OBJECT_PREPARED cannot be reclassified as Python return observed.
snapshot_surface.types: Exact executing kernel KernelSnapshot and RawCallSnapshot, alongside RawCallView. No copied type/decoded data is a brand.
